lines.en: I'm gonna leap!
Watch out, I'm leaping!
I'm gonna leap over!
Prepare to be tackled!
Leap and attack you!
Leap and split them open!
Leap up! Split them open!
Here I come, prepare to leap!
Leap attack! Split them open!
Knees bend, knees snap — I bounce forward.

lines.zh: 我不走路，我一级一级跳。
lines.en: I don't walk; I hop step by step.
My next hop lands behind you.
I just wait...
Wait for the leap chance.
Leap, wait for the chance.
Wait for my leap moment.
Leap, ready now.
Wait quietly, leap!
Wait for my leap, prey.
Leap is my wait.
Wait for the leap, here I come.
Leap, the time is right.

lines.zh: 你一进视野，我就要跳了。
lines.en: One step into my sight and I'll leap.
Found you, leap!
Target locked, leap.
Your position, leap.
Target clear, leap.
Target locked, ready to leap.
You're here, leap.
My target, leap.
Locked, leap!
Target locked, leap.
Fell down, injured leg.

lines.zh: 刀口开在大腿上，跳不动。
lines.en: The cut is across my thigh; I can't leap.
Can't chew this.
Wings broken.
Head smashed.
I jumped and hit the cave ceiling.

lines.zh: 跳歪了，膝盖砸在石头上。
lines.en: I jumped wrong and my knee hit stone.
Foot pinched.
I landed badly and my knee twisted.

lines.zh: 腿使不上劲，跳不起来了。
lines.en: My legs won't push; I can't jump.
It leaps and charges at you.

lines.zh: 你看到它的眼睛闪烁着光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow as it approaches.

lines.zh: 它的牙齿锋利，渴望鲜血。
lines.en: Its sharp teeth hunger for blood.

lines.zh: 它用强力一跃，试图抓住你。
lines.en: It leaps powerfully, trying to grab you.

lines.zh: 它的叫声在空旷中回荡。
lines.en: Its roar echoes in the open space.
It leaps at you, ready to bite.

lines.zh: 你感受到了它的强烈食欲。
lines.en: You feel its strong appetite.
It leaps up, ready to devour.

lines.zh: 它的跳跃如同幽灵般迅猛。
lines.en: Its leap is as swift as a ghost.

lines.zh: 我蹲低身子，准备跳过去。
lines.en: I crouch low, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的坚硬身躯。
lines.en: You collide with its hard body.
Its armor rings under the impact.

lines.zh: 它坚硬的护甲保护着它。
lines.en: Its tough armor protects it.

lines.zh: 它的跳跃使你难以躲避。
lines.en: Its leap makes it hard to dodge.
You feel pain from the collision.

lines.zh: 它撞击你，让你踉跄后退。
lines.en: It collides with you, making you stumble.
Its leap is powerful.
You are knocked away by its leap.
The collision injures you.
It collides with you, trying to stun you.

lines.zh: 我蹦到高处，闻风里的味道。
lines.en: I leap up high and sniff the wind.

lines.zh: 我跳一下，再叫一声，等回应。
lines.en: I hop once, call once, and wait for an answer.

lines.zh: 它的求偶叫声引来了同类。
lines.en: Its mating call attracts its kind.
It searches on the ground for a mate.

lines.zh: 它用跳跃的方式吸引对方。
lines.en: It uses leaps to attract a mate.
Its call is filled with desire.

lines.zh: 我们并排蹲着，谁也没跳。
lines.en: We crouch side by side; neither of us leaps.
It finds a mate and mates.

lines.zh: 它的求偶行为引来了注意。
lines.en: Its mating behavior draws attention.
It mates with another of its kind.
Sssss, I’m going to jump!
I’ll throw you!
Ahh, my target!
I've worked out where the leap lands.
I won’t die until I catch you!

lines.zh: 我跃起的落点，早就算好了。
lines.en: I already know where my leap will land.

lines.zh: 我落地时抓住的，是块骨头。
lines.en: What I caught on landing was a bone.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，跳也逃不掉！
lines.en: You can’t escape, not even by jumping!
My jump is deadly!
Got you, now eat it!
Sss, I see you!
Found you, I’m going to eat you!
This leap goes for your neck.
Sss, target clear!
I’m going to jump!

lines.zh: 你跑不掉的，我要吃了你！
lines.en: You can’t run, I’m going to eat you!
This leap goes straight for your face.
Jump up, I’m going to get you!
Ready to jump, grab the target!
Sss, I’m going to pounce!

lines.zh: 我听见脚步，膝盖先弯了。
lines.en: I hear steps and my knees bend first.

lines.zh: 有活物，这个距离够我跳。
lines.en: A living thing — close enough to jump.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，蓄着后腿的劲。
lines.en: I fix on you, loading my hind legs.

lines.zh: 你转身也没用，我跳得快。
lines.en: Turning won't help; I leap faster.
My rotten eyes brighten — locked on.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，膝盖弯成弓。
lines.en: I sink low and bend my knees like a bow.
Sss, targeting you!
I’m going to throw you!
Get ready to be caught!
Sss, I’m going to catch you!
I crouch low. That means I jump.
Sss, targeting you!
I’m going to jump!

lines.zh: 我数着你的呼吸，等第二下。
lines.en: I count your breaths, waiting for the second one.
Get you, I’m going to eat you!

lines.zh: 我蹲低，把力量压进脚掌。
lines.en: I crouch and drive the power into my feet.
This leap is aimed at your chest.
The moment you stop, I jump.
My landing spot is the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 别站在斜坡上，我要借势。
lines.en: Don't stand on the slope; I'll use the drop.
On two, I fly at you.
My rotten flesh draws taut like a bow.
You raise the shield high — I jump low.
Sssss, I’m leaping at you!
Leap at you, enjoy my leap!
Leap, grab you!
Bite you, leap attack!
Leap, devour you!
Leap, strike hard!
Here, my leap attack!
Defeat you with my leap!
Leap at you, rip you!
Leap attack, knock you down!
My whole body slams down!
I leap onto your back and hold tight!
Claws land first, teeth right after!
I knock you back three paces!
I land and bite your shoulder!
I leap and pin your shield down!
Rotten beings are awakening!

lines.zh: 准备好了，跃击即将开始！
lines.en: Ready, leap attack incoming!
Zombie leaps, battle ready!

lines.zh: 我从地下跃出，寻找猎物！
lines.en: I leap from the ground, seeking prey!
Leap at you, zombie’s leap!

lines.zh: 腐烂的灵魂跃起，吞噬你！
lines.en: 腐烂的灵魂跃起, devour you!
Leap at you, my leap!
Rotten zombie leaps out!
Leap attack, rip souls!
Leap from the ground, battle ready!

lines.zh: 泥土一鼓，我从坑里蹦出来。
lines.en: The dirt bulges and I spring out of the hole.

lines.zh: 第一件事就是试跳一次。
lines.en: The first thing I do is test a jump.
A reeking wind blows and I wake.
I hop onto a rock, then look for people.

lines.zh: 身上着火，跳得乱七八糟。
lines.en: I'm on fire, jumping all wrong.

lines.zh: 这一跳算错了，我砸在地上。
lines.en: I misjudged the leap and hit the ground hard.
I can't leap in water; I sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀到墙上，又弹回来。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the wall and I bounce back.
Hit mid-leap — bad luck.
Magic hit.
No flesh to eat, my legs have gone soft.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的腿窜上来，我抽了一下。
lines.en: The lightning runs up my legs; I jerk once.
This jump went far too far.
